headline: EPS rises sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: ISU Petasys reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩813, up 18.3% q/q from ₩687 and up 85.6% y/y from ₩438.
summary_long: EPS of ₩813 rose 18.3% sequentially from ₩687 and 85.6% year-over-year from ₩438. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
